Title: Q: Malk Time Auction and Atonement

Messages.Author: m.tom...@student.canberra.edu.au
Messages.Body:
Didi has an atonement, can the atonement be Auctioned via Malk Time
Auction?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
m.tom...@student.canberra.edu.au wrote:
>
> Didi has an atonement, can the atonement be Auctioned via Malk Time
> Auction?

Yes. Note that changing control of Atonement doesn't cause the
Atonement to move - it will still be on Didi. The target of the
action to burn it will be the (new) controller of the Atonement,
though.

> Since the Atonement is not being played but controlled:
> Can someone bid if they have no vamps in play?

Sure.

> What happens to the Atonement without a valid vamp to place it on? (when
> they win the auction)

They get control of it (and it remains on Didi).

> Can the atonement be placed on a >=6 cap vamp?

It can't be moved.

--

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Sorrow wrote:
>
> > > Out of curiosity, why can't it be moved? Because it's a card that you place on a
> > > minion?
> > It could be moved, I suppose, if there were any mechanism to do so.
> > Changing control says nothing about moving it, though. [LSJ 28-JAN-1998]
>
> So you auction off your Hunting Grounds and it doesn't move? How odd.

Um. HG isn't placed on anything. It's position is immaterial.
Control is control, and that's all that matters to HG.
Normally a card is moved to indicate change of control (that is,
if you control it, you place it "in front" of you to indicate that).
Cards played "on" something don't have that luxury, of course
(Haven Uncovered, e.g.).

> Say you auction your minion. That minion doesn't move, apparently, but
> does the new controller get to do anything with their new minion? And does
> it count as one of the new meth's ready minions even though it is it not in
> that meth's ready region?

See above. You control the minions you control. The minions you control
that are ready constitute your ready region.



> does the new controller get to do anything with their new minion? And does
> it count as one of the new meth's ready minions even though it is it not in
> that meth's ready region?

I think Scott means that cards which are played on other cards are not moved
to a new target. As always, the control of such cards is not necessarily
indicated by who controls the target card. If a card which is simply a permanent
in a Meth's controlled area changes owners, it would be moved to the new owner's
controlled area.

Fred

Heidelberg Castle, Germany [DS, FN]
Heidelburg Castle, Germany
Cardtype: Master
Cost: 2 pool
Master: unique location.
Tap to transfer equipment cards, move blood and transfer retainers between any
two ready vampires you control. (You may choose the amount of blood you move
and which cards you transfer.) Cannot be used during an action.

Tips on using Heidelburg:

#1. The minions who you transfer stuff between must be vampires (can't be
allies).

#2. The cards that can be transferred are equipment and retainers (and you can
move blood too). Loquipment is not considered to be equipment while in play and
cannot be transferred via Heidelburg. Cards in play like Atonement are
similarly not allowed to be moved with Heidelburg.

#3. Final note: just don't forget to remember that Heidelburg can't be used
during an action.

Halcyan 2
